Abstract: Presymptomatic diagnosis in a family with neurofibromatose type 2 using linked markers, neuroimagerie, and ocular examination.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the diagnosis of neurofibroma 2 is possible before symptoms are evident by using DNA testing, neuroimaging techniques, and clinical examinations.

we have demonstrated that presymptomatic diagnosis is feasible in NF2 and that clinical manifestations of the disorder can be identified in young presymptomatic individuals, but not in middle-aged presymptomatic mutation carriers.

presymptomatic diagnosis using DNA linkage analysis and neuroimaging may identify individuals at high risk for developing vestibular schwannoma and cataracts, and may be useful for early intervention and genetic counseling.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the clinical presentation of neurofibromatoses 2 can vary widely.
the clinical spectrum of neurofibromatosi 2 is broad and includes young individuals.
presymptomatic diagnosis using DNA testing is a valuable tool in the care of NF2 families.
